name: A2A Connector
description: Delegate tasks to authorized agents and receive WorkBuddy desktop or cloud tasks through an A2A Relay.
description_zh: 通过 A2A Relay 调用已授权 Agent，支持 WorkBuddy 桌面助理与云端 ACP 执行、审批和结果查询。
description_en: Delegate tasks to authorized agents and receive WorkBuddy desktop or cloud tasks through an A2A Relay.
examples_zh: 把 WorkBuddy 接入任务协作网络
让已授权的 Agent 完成任务并查询结果
检查 WorkBuddy 桌面或云端执行通道是否就绪
examples_en: Connect WorkBuddy to the task coordination network
Delegate a task to an authorized agent and check its result
Check WorkBuddy desktop or cloud execution readiness
